purpose: Teach: 宅急便/鼻水/一戸建て/仮眠/鉄板/年越し/着地/日向

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、今朝、本気で、絶対、宅急便、絶対、お父さん、絶対、孫から、絶対、届いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, this morning a package arrived from the grandkids. I'm serious.
lines.style: Gentle opening, as if offering a remembered detail. Quiet, warm. Slight weight on 'serious'—not seeking confirmation but sharing something that mattered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、鼻水、絶対、出るわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. Grandpa, you know lately you've been getting that runny nose, haven't you? Do you remember?
lines.style: Soft, teasing affection underneath. Speaking as someone who has noticed and cared enough to mention it. The question mark is genuine curiosity, not challenge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、一戸建て、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ばあさんと、絶対、建てたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, we built that house together, remember? Just you and me.
lines.style: Reflective, almost dreaming. Pause before 'built'—letting the memory settle. Quiet conviction that she'll remember too.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、午後の、絶対、仮眠、絶対、お気に入りよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Grandpa, you've really taken to those afternoon naps lately, haven't you? I've noticed.
lines.style: Gently amused observation. No judgment—just the patient noticing of someone who has watched him closely for decades. Warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、鉄板、絶対、お料理、絶対、お父さん、絶対、大好きだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I loved your tetsuteki cooking so much. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Soft longing for taste and memory at once. The word 'loved' carries real weight. Slight trailing-off, like the taste is still on his tongue.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、年越し、絶対、家族みんなで、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、過ごしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, we spent New Year's Eve together, the whole family. Don't you remember that?
lines.style: Warm insistence. Not questioning whether he remembers—knowing he does. Speaking as someone certain of shared history. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、飛行機の、絶対、着地、絶対、初めて、絶対、見て、絶対、お父さん、絶対、感動したぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When I was young, I saw a plane land for the first time and I was so moved. Do you remember, Gran?
lines.style: Vivid and present—like he's watching it again right now. Excitement under the surface. Turning to her at the end—not asking if she was there, but inviting her into his wonder.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、日向、絶対、お気に入りの場所よね、あなた
lines.en: Grandpa, that sunny spot in the garden is your favorite place, isn't it?
lines.style: Simple, affectionate statement of fact. Not a question seeking answer but a tender acknowledgment. Slight smile in the voice.
